agency.name: Industrial Commission of Arizona (ICA), Claims Division

ttd.basisLabel: Gross monthly wage at the time of injury
ttd.rateText: 66 2/3% of the average monthly wage during the period of disability, plus a flat $100 per month if persons are dependent on the employee (A.R.S. § 23-1045(A)); wages above the ICA's maximum average monthly wage are excluded (A.R.S. § 23-1041(D)-(E)).
ttd.minText: Arizona has no statutory minimum TTD rate in A.R.S. § 23-1045.
ttd.periodLabel: injuries sustained January 1 - December 31, 2026 (maximum average monthly wage $6,131.00; $6,333.32 adopted for 2027); weekly maximum = 66.67% of the maximum average monthly wage $6,131.00 × 12 ÷ 52

waiting.text: Compensation is not paid for the first seven days after the injury; if incapacity extends beyond seven days compensation begins on the eighth day, and if disability continues one week beyond those seven days it is computed from the date of injury (A.R.S. § 23-1062(D)).

ttdDuration.text: TTD is paid during the period of disability; no fixed week cap (A.R.S. § 23-1045(A)(1)).

ppd.text: Scheduled injuries are paid at 55% of the average monthly wage for a fixed number of months (e.g. thumb 15, major hand 50, leg 50, major arm 60, hearing in both ears 60), in addition to TTD; partial loss of use is paid at 50% for the proportional months; unscheduled injuries pay 55% of the difference between pre-injury average monthly wage and reduced monthly earning capacity (A.R.S. § 23-1044(B)-(C)).

facts.text: Arizona computes benefits on a monthly, not weekly, basis: the average monthly wage at the time of injury (A.R.S. § 23-1041(A)).

The maximum average monthly wage is indexed each year to the BLS Employment Cost Index for Wages and Salaries, adopted by the ICA by August 1 for the next calendar year, and cannot fall or rise more than 5% per year (A.R.S. § 23-1041(E); A.A.C. R20-15-165).
A TTD claimant with dependents receives exactly $100 more per month in total, regardless of the number of dependents (A.R.S. § 23-1045(A)(2)).
The first installment is due no later than the 21st day after the ICA notifies the carrier of the claim; TTD is then paid at least every two weeks (A.R.S. § 23-1062(D)).
Medical benefits include reimbursement of reasonable travel expenses when the employee must travel more than 25 miles from home for care (A.R.S. § 23-1062(C)).
